# Third party notices

No upstream source or model file is copied into the bootstrap. The only redistributed third-party files are the brand-kit fonts, whose license texts stay beside the fonts:

- `brand/fonts/PublicSans-LICENSE.md` - Public Sans (SIL OFL 1.1 with CC0 1.0 for GSA modifications)
- `brand/fonts/IBMPlex-LICENSE.txt` - IBM Plex Mono (SIL OFL 1.1)

Before an owner copies another upstream file or model asset, they must add the corresponding notice here and update `third_party/manifest.json` with the exact copied paths and local changes.
